# Product Requirements Document (PRD)
# Rayvoy Overseas — Education CRM & Study Abroad Platform

**Version:** 4.0 (Full Stack)
**Status:** Active Development
**Last Updated:** April 2026
**Audience:** Development Team, QA, AI Testing Tools
**Stack:** Next.js 16 · React 19 · Supabase · Tailwind CSS v4 · MUI v7 · Framer Motion · GSAP

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Product Overview

### 1.1 What Is Rayvoy?
Rayvoy is a full-stack web platform serving two distinct audiences simultaneously:

1. **Public-Facing Portal (`/app/(public)/`)** — A beautifully designed, animated marketing website that communicates Rayvoy's services, builds brand trust, and captures leads through high-converting contact forms and popups. The public portal is the top of the recruitment funnel.

2. **Admin Dashboard (`/admin/*`)** — An enterprise-grade CRM and student management system purpose-built to replace Excel-based operations. It operationalises the entire student recruitment lifecycle — from initial inquiry to visa approval and enrollment.

Both surfaces are tightly integrated: a public form submission instantly materialises as a lead card in the admin pipeline.

### 1.2 Business Context & Problem Statement
Until Rayvoy, the team tracked 1,000+ student leads across spreadsheets (e.g., `CRM - Mastersheet.csv`, `Muskan-Applications_UK_2026.csv`). This created:
- No single source of truth for lead status.
- Manual, error-prone stage progression (e.g., "Documents Pending" → "Application Sent").
- No audit trail for who contacted whom and when.
- No enforcement of data privacy rules (GDPR opt-out tracking).
- No analytics to measure counselor performance or pipeline health.

Rayvoy solves all of these problems in a single, permission-controlled web application.

### 1.3 Target Users

| Role | Description | Key Permissions |
|---|---|---|
| **Super Admin** | Designated via `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL` env variable | Full system access: add leads, import CSV, delete leads, manage users, view all settings, reassign leads |
| **Admin / Counselor** | Regular staff member whitelisted in `allowed_users` table | CRM access, lead interaction, document review. Cannot modify users or import data |
| **Public User (Candidate)** | Prospective student browsing the marketing website | Can view all public pages and submit contact/inquiry forms |

---

# PART 1 — PUBLIC-FACING PORTAL
## (`/app/(public)/`)

---

## 2. Global Layout (All Public Pages)

### 2.1 Navbar (`layout/Navbar.tsx`)
A fixed, transparent top navigation bar (`z-10`, `h-16`) with intelligent scroll and route awareness:

- **Logo:** "RAYVOY" bold uppercase wordmark as a `<Link>` to `/`.
- **Desktop Nav Links:** Rendered from a `menuItems` configuration.
  - Links **fade out** (`opacity-0 pointer-events-none`) after the user scrolls past **20px** — the hamburger becomes the sole navigation method once scrolled. This enforces a clean, immersive scroll experience.
  - The home page link is hidden when already on `/`.
- **Dark-Section Awareness (About Page Only):** When on `/about` and scrolled past 94% of `viewportHeight`, nav links and the hamburger switch to `text-white` automatically to remain readable over the dark `#121212` section.
- **Hamburger Button:** Always visible. Opens a full-screen `NavbarDrawer` overlay slide-in with all navigation links.
- **Behaviour:** Automatically closes the drawer on route change.

### 2.2 Footer (`layout/Footer.tsx`)
A rich, animated multi-column footer using Framer Motion's `motion.footer` with spring layout transitions. Contains:

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| **Brand & Social** | "RAYVOY" wordmark · tagline "Your Dream. Your Country. Your Course." · Social icons: Instagram (`@raayvoy`), WhatsApp (direct link), Email (`support.teams@rayvoy.com`) |
| **Navigation** | Home · About · Services · Blog · Contact |
| **Services** | University Shortlisting · SOP & Essays · Scholarship Guidance · Visa Assistance · Pre-Departure Help · 1-on-1 Counselling |
| **Calculators** | Academic calculator tools — opens `CalculatorDrawer` bottom sheet on click |
| **Contact & Location** | `support.teams@rayvoy.com` · `+91 8904650987` · 78/79, 30th Cross Rd, Jayanagar, Bengaluru 560011 |
| **Legal Bar (bottom)** | Privacy Policy · Terms of Service · Refund Policy · © {year} RAYVOY |

### 2.3 WhatsApp Floating Button (`layout/WhatsAppButton.tsx`)
A persistent floating WhatsApp CTA button visible on all public pages, linking to Rayvoy's WhatsApp business line.

---

## 3. Home Page (`/`)

A full-screen, multi-section landing page composed of the following sections in order:

### 3.1 Hero Section (`home/HeroSection/`)
A full-viewport-height (`min-h-svh`) section with a cream (`bg-brand-cream`) background.

**Layout (Flex Column — text above, map below):**

**HeroContent (foreground):**
- `ActiveAnnouncement` pill banner (if a live announcement exists in Supabase — managed via admin CMS).
- **H1:** "Your Study Abroad Journey Has No Border" — uppercase, `Mulish` font, `text-brand-darksoftPeriwinkle`.
- **Tagline:** "At Rayvoy, we guide students across multiple global destinations — helping them choose the right country, the right university, and the right path for their future."
- **CTA Button: "Start Your Journey"** — a rounded pill button (`rounded-full`) with:
  - Left-to-right fill hover animation using `brand-wisteriaBlue`.
  - Glow shadow: `shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(142,148,242,0.3)]`.
  - Clicking opens the `HeroPopup` via the `ExpandableScreen` component with an expand-into-full-screen animation.

**MapSection (below text):**
- A custom interactive `WorldMap` SVG component rendered wide across the page.
- `pointer-events-none` and `aria-hidden="true"` — purely decorative.

### 3.2 Hero Popup — "Start Your Journey" (`home/HeroSection/HeroPopup.tsx`)
A glassmorphism modal card — `bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/50 rounded-[28px]`. Opens via `ExpandableScreen`. Two-panel layout:

**Left Panel (desktop, hidden on mobile):**
- Globe icon in a branded container.
- "Rayvoy / Start Your Journey" label + heading.
- Description: "Let us guide you to the right university, country, and path for your future."
- Checklist:
  - ✓ University shortlisting
  - ✓ Visa & documentation support
  - ✓ Scholarship guidance
  - ✓ Pre-departure briefings

**Right Panel (form):**
- **Full Name** — text input, max 50 chars, min 2 chars.
- **Phone Number** — tel input, digits only, 7–15 chars, with **country code selector**:
  - 🇮🇳 +91 · 🇺🇸 +1 · 🇬🇧 +44 · 🇦🇺 +61 · 🇨🇦 +1 · 🇸🇬 +65 · 🇫🇷 +33 · 🇩🇪 +49 · 🇳🇿 +64 · 🇮🇪 +353 · 🇦🇪 +971
- **Submit Button: "Continue"** — disabled until form is valid. Shows "Submitting..." state.
- On submit: inserts a record into the `student_inquiries` Supabase table with `service_type: 'general'` and `service_title: 'Start Your Journey'`.
- On success: animates to a **Thank You screen** — "Thank you, {name}! Our team will reach out to you shortly at {phone}." with a checkmark animation.
- Legal disclaimer links to `/terms-and-conditions` and `/privacy-policy`.

### 3.3 Active Announcements Banner (`home/ActiveAnnouncement.tsx`)
Rendered above the H1 in the hero. Fetches live announcements from Supabase. Managed by admins via the CMS dashboard (`/admin/annoucment`).

### 3.4 Services Carousel (`home/Service/`)
An interactive horizontal carousel of Rayvoy's 6 core services. Each card has an icon, title, description, 3 feature bullets, and a unique CTA button. Each CTA opens a **Service Popup** using the `ExpandableScreen` or modal system.

| # | Service | CTA | Popup Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | University Shortlisting | "Find my University" | `UniversityShortlistingPopup` (full multi-step flow) |
| 2 | English Proficiency Exams (IELTS, TOEFL, PTE) | "Prep for my Exam" | `ServicePopup` (`ept`) |
| 3 | Scholarship Guidance | "Find Scholarships" | `ServicePopup` (`scholarship`) |
| 4 | Visa Assistance (96% approval rate) | "Start my Visa" | `ServicePopup` (`visa`) |
| 5 | Education Loan | "Check Loan Options" | `ServicePopup` (`loan`) |
| 6 | Student Accommodation | "Find my Stay" | `ServicePopup` (`accommodation`) |

The `UniversityShortlistingPopup` (`home/Service/UniversityShortlistingPopup.tsx`) is the most complex popup — it walks users through a multi-step matching flow based on profile type, country preference, budget, and degree level.

### 3.5 University Partners Grid (`home/UniversityPatners/UniversityPartnersGrid.tsx`)
A branded grid/logo strip showcasing partner universities to build credibility and trust.

### 3.6 FAQ Accordion (`home/FAQ-Section/`)
An in-page accordion component answering common student questions directly on the home page, reducing friction for prospective students.

---

## 4. About Page (`/about`)

A typographically rich, editorial-style page using **Playfair Display** serif font throughout.

### Sections (in order):

**1. Our Story (Two-Column Grid)**
- Left: Large sticky `h1` — "Our Story." in Playfair Display (`text-5xl` → `text-8xl`).
- Right: Three flowing paragraphs:
  - *Para 1 (italic, large):* "Founded in 2025 by two visionary professionals with extensive experience in international education..."
  - *Para 2:* Context on founders mentoring students before forming the company.
  - *Para 3:* Philosophy — mentors, strategists, and partners in global journeys.

**2. Mission / Values / Vision (Three-Column Grid)**
| Pillar | Description |
|---|---|
| Our Mission | Personalised, honest, reliable study abroad guidance across every stage of the journey |
| Our Values | Transparency, student-first thinking, genuine care. No hidden fees, no false promises |
| Our Vision | Empower students to become global citizens through quality international education |

**3. About Article Section**
A rich editorial text block in a two-column layout with an italic blockquote bordered by `brand-softPeriwinkle` — featuring the core company philosophy including a statement that students with gaps, low grades, or age barriers are still encouraged to reach out.

**4. Our Methodology — "The Simple Way" (8-Step Architectural Grid)**
An 8-column grid where each cell has a hover animation (top border slides in from left, background transitions to white):

| Step | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | Reach Out to Us | Get personalised 1:1 counselling from expert advisors |
| 02 | Profile Evaluation | Counsellors evaluate academic profile, experience, and goals |
| 03 | Personalised Shortlisting | Tailored list of universities aligned with background and plans |
| 04 | Application Submission | Applications submitted promptly on the same day once confirmed |
| 05 | Offer Letter | Rayvoy takes responsibility for securing the offer letter |
| 06 | Tuition Fee Payment | Guided through making the initial tuition deposit to the university |
| 07 | Visa Application | Full visa process — documentation, submission, appointments |
| 08 | Time to Fly | Visa received. Pack your bags. Begin your global journey |

> [!NOTE]
> The About page has a dark section (`#121212` background) that starts at 94% of viewport height. The Navbar detects this intersection and switches to `text-white` mode automatically.

---

## 5. Services Page (`/services`)

An editorial list-layout page with a `Services Portfolio.` hero heading (Playfair Display, `text-5xl` → `text-8xl`).

**8 Services listed in full editorial detail:**

| # | Service | Description | Key Features |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | Profile & Career Counselling | In-depth evaluation of academic background, career ambitions, and budget | Extensive profile analysis · Career trajectory mapping · Course & country selection |
| 02 | Test Preparation & Waivers | Strategic guidance for IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, GRE, GMAT; includes waiver spotting | IELTS/TOEFL strategies · Waiver eligibility checks · Free diagnostic assessments |
| 03 | Smart University Shortlisting | Personalised, data-backed shortlisting balancing aspirations and admission probability | Safety/Target/Dream mix · Post-study ROI analysis · Custom application strategy |
| 04 | Documentation & Applications | Crafting winning SOPs, refining LORs, and flawless application filing | SOP & Essay editing · Resume & LOR structuring · Application fee waiver support |
| 05 | Education & Financial Loans | End-to-end financial planning including non-collateral loan options | Fast-track approvals · Non-collateral loan options · Comprehensive financial docs |
| 06 | Scholarship Assistance | Dedicated support for merit-based and need-based scholarships globally | University-specific grants · Optimised application strategies · Deadline tracking |
| 07 | Visa Processing & Mock Interviews | Complete visa support with mock interviews and financial proof structuring | Mock visa interview prep · Financial proof structuring · Embassy appointment booking |
| 08 | Post-Arrival & Accommodation | Seamless transition support — housing, forex, travel | Student housing assistance · Forex & international banking · Air-ticket & transit |

Each row is hover-activated (`hover:bg-white/40 transition-colors`) with animated feature bullets (dot colour transitions on hover).

**Bottom CTA Block:** A prominent white card (`rounded-[2.5rem] shadow-2xl`) with "Ready to begin your journey?" and a **"Book a Free Session"** button (`<Button href="/contact">`).

---

## 6. Contact Page (`/contact`)

A premium 1-on-1 counselling booking page with `Get 1 on 1 Counselling Session.` as its Playfair Display hero heading.

**Form Fields (all required, validated with React Hook Form + Zod):**

| Field | Type | Validation |
|---|---|---|
| Full Name | Text input | Required |
| Email Address | Email input | Required, valid email format |
| Phone Number | Tel input | Required |
| Destination Country | Radix UI Select | Required. Options: USA · UK · Canada · Australia · Germany · Other |
| Message | Textarea (resizable) | Required |

**UX Details:**
- All inputs use a borderless underline style (`border-b`) that animates `border-brand-softPeriwinkle` on focus.
- Inline error messages appear in italic Playfair Display below each field in `rose-500` colour.
- Submit button fills left-to-right with `brand-wisteriaBlue` on hover.
- On success: transitions to a full "**Thank You**" state — giant Playfair heading, confirmation message ("Our study abroad counsellors will reach out to you directly within 24 hours"), and a "Send another message" link.

> [!WARNING]
> The contact form currently only logs to the console and simulates a 1s delay. Backend persistence to Supabase / CRM lead creation is **not yet implemented**.

---

## 7. Blog (`/blog`, `/blog/[slug]`)
- `/blog` — Public listing of all published blog posts.
- `/blog/[slug]` — Individual blog post pages.
- Content is managed via the admin CMS module (`/admin/blog`).

---

## 8. Academic Calculators (`CalculatorDrawer.tsx`)
Launched from the **Footer → Calculators column**. Opens as a slide-up bottom-sheet drawer. Contains academic conversion tools:
- **CGPA → GPA** conversion.
- Additional calculators accessible via `CALC_TYPES` / `CALC_LABELS` constants in `CalculatorDrawer.tsx`.

---

## 9. Legal Pages
| Page | Route |
|---|---|
| Privacy Policy | `/privacy-policy` |
| Terms & Conditions | `/terms-and-conditions` |
| Refund Policy | `/refund-policy` |

---

# PART 2 — ADMIN DASHBOARD
## (`/admin/*`)

---

## 10. Authentication & Access Control

### 10.1 Authentication Methods
- **Email/Password login** via Supabase Auth.
- **Google OAuth** via Supabase Auth provider.
- All authentication routes handled at `/auth/login`.
- Post-login redirect to `/admin/crm`.

### 10.2 Whitelist-Based Access Control
- Access to the admin dashboard is restricted to users whose email exists in the `allowed_users` Supabase table with `is_active = true`.
- The middleware enforces this check on **every request** — not just at login time. Deactivating a user takes effect near-instantly on their next navigation.
- A user with `is_active = false` is redirected to `/auth/login`.

### 10.3 Super Admin Privileges
The Super Admin is a single email stored in `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL`. This user receives exclusive UI affordances:
- **"Add Lead"** button in the CRM toolbar.
- **"Import CSV"** button in the CRM toolbar.
- **"Delete Leads"** button in the CRM toolbar.
- **"Users"**, **"Login History"**, and **"Profile"** sidebar navigation links.
- Ability to **reassign leads** to other counselors from within the Lead Drawer.

Regular admins can only view and interact with existing leads — none of these UI elements are rendered for them.

### 10.4 Audit / Login History (`/admin/login-history`)
Super Admin only. Displays a log of who logged in, from what device/IP, and when.

---

## 11. CRM Pipeline — Lead Management (`/admin/crm`)

The primary workspace. A real-time pipeline view of all active leads.

### 11.1 Pipeline Views
- **Kanban Board** (`pipeline-board.tsx`) — Cards in vertical stage columns, scrolling horizontally. **Default view.**
- **List View** (`pipeline-list-view.tsx`) — Dense tabular list, sorted by recency. Best for scanning large volumes.

View toggle in the filter bar switches between modes.

### 11.2 Pipeline Stages
Fetched from `config.pipelines` and `config.stages` via `useCrmConfig` hook:
- Ordered by `order_index`.
- Each stage has a `color_hex` for card and column colouring.
- Stages marked `is_terminal` are hidden from the Lead Drawer stage selector to prevent accidental terminal moves.

### 11.3 Lead Sources
Leads are tagged with acquisition source for filtering and reporting:
`Organic` · `Facebook Ad` · `Google Ad` · `Referral` · `Walk-in`

### 11.4 Dashboard Statistics Bar
Four live stat cards at the top of the CRM page:

| Card | Value |
|---|---|
| **Total Leads** | Count of all non-archived leads in active pipeline |
| **Hot Leads** | Count where `is_hot = true` |
| **Unassigned** | Count with no `assigned_to` |
| **Avg Score** | Mean of all `lead_score` values |

### 11.5 Filter Bar
- **Full-text search:** name, phone, email, target country, destination country.
- **Source filter pills:** All Sources · Organic · Facebook · Google · Referral · Walk-in.
- **Assignee dropdown:** All Counselors / Unassigned / per-counselor.
- **Results counter:** "N of M leads" shown in real time.

### 11.6 Super Admin-Only Toolbar Actions

**Add Lead → `AddLeadModal`**
Manually create a lead with: Name, email, phone (with country code), source, campaign, target country, course interest, degree, field of study, intake year, marks %, backlogs, initial pipeline/stage, assigned counselor.

**Import CSV → `ImportCsvModal`**
Upload a `.csv` file. System maps CSV columns to CRM fields and bulk-inserts records into `crm_leads`.

**Delete Leads → `DeleteLeadsModal`**
Bulk-select and permanently delete lead records.

---

## 12. Lead Drawer — Deep Lead Detail Panel

Clicking any lead card opens a **50vw right-side panel** with a backdrop blur overlay (`z-50`). The command center for a single lead's full lifecycle.

### 12.1 Header
- **Initials avatar** — orange/red gradient for hot leads; purple gradient for standard leads.
- **Name & Badges:** Lead name · 🔥 "HOT" badge (if `is_hot`) · 🚫 "DNC" badge (if `opted_out`).
- **Contact Info:** Phone (with country code) · email.
- **Lead Score:** Prominent numeric score (top-right). Colour-coded:
  - 🟢 Green: score ≥ 70
  - 🟡 Amber: score 40–69
  - 🔴 Red/Primary: score < 40

### 12.2 Stage Selector
One button per non-terminal stage. Active stage highlighted with `color_hex` and a matching glow shadow. Clicking moves the lead and logs a `stage_change` event.

### 12.3 Tabs (7 Total)

**Tab 1: Overview**
| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| Assigned Counselor | Dropdown (Super Admin only can change). Shows current assignment or "— Unassigned —" |
| Lead Details | Source · Campaign · Country · Course Interest · Service Type · Degree · Field of Study · Marks % · Intake Year · Backlogs |
| Tags | Colour-coded pill badges: e.g., `#uk_2026`, `#finance` |
| Pinned Note | Amber-highlighted sticky note showing the last saved note |
| DNC Toggle | GDPR opt-out flag. Blocks messaging when enabled. Toggle logs an `opt_out` event |
| Activity Timestamps | Received · Last Contacted · First Response · Last Assigned |

---

**Tab 2: Timeline**
Chronological activity log rendered as a vertical timeline with line connector:

| Event Type | Icon | Badge Color |
|---|---|---|
| `form_submit` | Document | Brand primary |
| `stage_change` | Pipeline arrows | Blue |
| `call_log` | Phone | Green |
| `note_added` | Pencil | Yellow |
| `email_sent` | Envelope | Sky |
| `whatsapp_sent` | Chat bubble | Green |
| `sms_sent` | Phone partial | Purple |
| `doc_uploaded` | File | Amber |
| `score_change` | Waveform | Brand primary |
| `assignment_change` | Person | Cyan |
| `appointment_booked` | Calendar | Blue |
| `appointment_attended` | Calendar check | Green |
| `opt_out` | Shield off | Red |

Each event displays: icon · event label badge · relative time ("2 hours ago") · actor name · metadata key-value block (if present).

---

**Tab 3: Tasks**
- Task list: type · notes · due date/time · status badge (`pending` / `done` / `overdue`).
- **Create Task Form:**
  - Task Type: `call` · `follow_up` · `send_email` · `review_docs` · `appointment`
  - Due At: datetime picker
  - Notes: optional free-text

---

**Tab 4: Appointments**
- Appointment list: medium · date · status badge (`scheduled` / `attended` / `no_show`) · clickable meeting link.
- **Book Appointment Form:**
  - Medium: `Phone` · `Video Call` · `In Person`
  - Scheduled At: datetime picker
  - Meeting Link: optional URL (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.)

---

**Tab 5: Docs (Documents)**
- List of uploaded documents: `file_type` · `file_name` · verification status badge (`pending` / `verified` / `rejected`) · "View ↗" link to Supabase Storage URL.

> [!NOTE]
> Document upload is initiated through the Add Lead modal. Direct upload from this tab is planned.

---

**Tab 6: Apps (Applications)**
Lists all university applications linked to this lead. Each application card exposes **inline editable fields** (changes saved on blur via `updateApplication`):

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| University Name | Display |
| Course Name | Display |
| Intake | Display (e.g., "Sep 2026") |
| Application Status | Select: `Shortlisted` / `Applied` / `Admitted` / `Rejected` |
| Offer Type | Select: `No Offer Yet` / `Conditional Offer` / `Unconditional Offer` / `Awaiting Offer` |
| Tuition Fee Amount | Number input |
| Deposit Amount | Number input |
| Scholarship Name | Text input |
| Scholarship Amount | Number input |
| Priority Rank | Number input |
| IELTS Requirement | Text input (e.g., "6.5") |
| Application Portal URL | URL input (clickable) |
| Offer PDF URL | URL input (clickable) |

**Add Application Form** at the bottom: University Name · Course Name · Intake.

---

**Tab 7: Actions**
| Action | Description |
|---|---|
| **Send Message** | Opens `SendMessageModal`. Sends templated Email / WhatsApp / SMS. Blocked with warning if lead has DNC flag |
| **Log a Call** | Records call result: `Connected` · `No Answer` · `Callback Requested` · `Not Interested` · `Voicemail`. Creates `call_log` event + updates `last_contacted_at` |
| **Add Note** | Free-text area. Saves as `note_added` event and updates sticky note on lead |
| **Archive Lead** | Soft-delete: removes from pipeline view and metrics but keeps record searchable in Smart Views (in a red "Danger Zone" card) |

---

## 13. CRM Configuration Modules

Admin-only sub-pages for configuring the CRM engine:

| Module | Route | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Scoring Rules | `/admin/crm/scoring-rules` | Define rules that auto-adjust `lead_score` on attributes (e.g., marks > 80 → +20) |
| SLA Management | `/admin/crm/sla` | Set response time SLAs; breaches trigger alerts |
| Workflow Automation | `/admin/crm/workflows` | Event-triggered automations (e.g., stage change → send WhatsApp template) |
| Smart Views | `/admin/crm/smart-views` | Saved filter presets (e.g., "My hot leads", "Uncontacted Facebook leads") |
| Templates | `/admin/crm/templates` | Email / WhatsApp / SMS message templates |
| Campaigns | `/admin/crm/campaigns` | Marketing campaign attribution tracking |
| Appointments (Global) | `/admin/crm/appointments` | Team-wide upcoming appointments calendar |
| Tasks (Global) | `/admin/crm/tasks` | Team-wide pending/overdue task board |
| Analytics | `/admin/crm/analytics` | Funnel analysis, conversion rates, counselor performance |
| Webhooks | `/admin/crm/webhooks` | Inbound/outbound integrations (Facebook Lead Ads, Google Forms) |

---

## 14. Student Information Module (`/admin/student-info`)

A separate module for students who have progressed beyond the lead stage. Main view: a searchable data table (`student-inquiries-table.tsx`) tracking:
- Personal details (name, contact, nationality)
- Academic history (degree, GPA/marks, field of study)
- University applications tied to the student
- Financial status of their applications

---

## 15. Admin Dashboard Home (`/admin`)

The landing page after login. Displays a high-level operational overview:
- Total leads, recent activity, and pipeline health indicators.
- Live announcement banner (if any active announcements are published via the CMS).
- Quick-access links to core modules: CRM, Student Info, Charts, Blog.

---

## 16. Analytics & Charts (`/admin/chart`)

Dedicated analytics page with dark-mode compatible chart components (MUI X-Charts):
- **StudentLineChart** — Trend over time (e.g., weekly lead volume, application rates)
- **StudentBarChart** — Comparative data (e.g., leads by counselor, leads by source)
- **StudentPieChart** — Proportional breakdowns (e.g., lead source distribution, status split)

All charts use explicit colour overrides to ensure full dark mode compatibility.

---

## 17. Admin CMS

| Module | Route | Where It Appears |
|---|---|---|
| Announcements | `/admin/annoucment` | Home page hero section banner (`ActiveAnnouncement`) |
| Blog | `/admin/blog` | Public `/blog` and `/blog/[slug]` pages |
| FAQ | `/admin/faq` | Home page FAQ accordion section |

---

## 18. Team Administration

### 18.1 User Management (`/admin/users`)
Super Admin only. Full CRUD on the `allowed_users` table:
- View all staff: full name, email, role, `is_active` status.
- Toggle `is_active` — instant access revocation on next request.
- Create new users via a dedicated onboarding flow → `/api/admin/create-user`.

### 18.2 Profile (`/admin/profile`)
Super Admin only. Update own display name and avatar.

---

# PART 3 — TECHNICAL REFERENCE

---

## 19. Design Language & Brand

### 19.1 Color Palette

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `brand-cream` | Off-white cream | All public page backgrounds |
| `brand-nearBlack` | Deep near-black | Primary text, large headings |
| `brand-softPeriwinkle` | `#8e94f2` (periwinkle) | Primary public brand accent, CTAs |
| `brand-wisteriaBlue` | Deeper blue-purple | CTA hover fill state |
| `brand-darksoftPeriwinkle` | Dark periwinkle | Hero section `<h1>` |
| `brand-deepPurple` | Muted deep purple | Hero tagline body text |
| `brand-warmGray` | Warm gray | Secondary body text |
| `brand-lavenderGrey` | Lavender gray | Labels, captions |
| `brand-lightGray` | Light gray | Borders, dividers |
| `brand-mauve` | Muted mauve | Backgrounds, accents |
| Dashboard Primary | `#5750F1` | Admin CRM primary accent colour |

### 19.2 Typography
| Font | Usage |
|---|---|
| **Playfair Display** (`playfair`) | All large public page headings (About, Services, Contact) |
| **Mulish** (`mulish`) | Hero section `<h1>` |
| **System / Inter / Outfit** | Admin dashboard UI text (via Tailwind + Google Fonts) |

### 19.3 Animation Stack
| Tool | Usage |
|---|---|
| **Framer Motion** | Page transitions, footer layout animation (`motion.footer`), button micro-animations |
| **GSAP** | Complex scroll scenes, WorldMap animation |
| **CSS Transitions** | All hover states (150ms–500ms), button fills, border colour changes |
| **`ExpandableScreen`** | Custom component managing full-screen expand/collapse for Hero Popup and Service Popups |

### 19.4 Admin Dark Mode
Full dark mode using `next-themes` (class strategy). All admin components use `dark:` Tailwind variants. MUI components use explicit colour token overrides. The public portal is exclusively **light-themed** (cream background).

### 19.5 Admin Z-Index Layering
- Sidebar/header: lowest z-index.
- Modals/drawers: `z-40` (backdrop) / `z-50` (panel).
- Custom scrollbars: `.custom-scrollbar` utility class.

## 22. Complete User Flows

### 21.1 Hero Popup → `student_inquiries`
```
Visitor → Home page → "Start Your Journey" button
  → ExpandableScreen animation → HeroPopup
  → Enter name + phone → "Continue"
  → INSERT student_inquiries (Supabase) → Thank You screen
```

### 21.2 Contact Form → CRM *(planned)*
```
Visitor → /contact → Fill Name, Email, Phone, Country, Message → Submit
  → [Planned: POST /api/route → INSERT crm_leads → notify counselors]
  → Thank You state
```

### 21.3 Full Student Lifecycle (Admin CRM)
```
Lead created → Counselor opens Lead Drawer
  → Reviews Overview tab (source, country, degree)
  → Actions tab → Logs call "Connected" → call_log event created
  → Stage → "Documents Pending" → stage_change event
  → Tasks tab → Creates "Review Docs" task with due date
  → Documents received → Stage → "Application Sent"
  → Apps tab → Adds university application (shortlisted)
  → Offer received → Updates offer_type "Unconditional Offer"
  → Books appointment (Video Call) → appointment_booked event
  → Stage → "Enrolled" (terminal) → lead archived from active view
```

### 21.4 Team Management (Super Admin)
```
Super Admin → /admin/users → "Create User"
  → POST /api/admin/create-user → New row in allowed_users (is_active: true)
  → Counselor logs in → Passes whitelist check → Accesses CRM

Super Admin deactivates user:
  → Toggle is_active = false in /admin/users
  → Deactivated user's next request → Middleware check fails → Redirect /auth/login
```

## 23. Non-Functional Requirements

### 23.1 Security
- All admin routes protected by middleware authentication checks.
- `allowed_users.is_active` enforced on every request (not just login).
- Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies enforced at the database layer.
- GDPR compliance: DNC opt-out flag prevents messaging opted-out leads.
- Zod schema validation on all form inputs (public and admin).
- All admin API routes validate JWT and user role before executing mutations.

### 23.2 Performance
- SWR for client-side caching with background revalidation.
- Vercel Analytics + Speed Insights on public pages.
- Next.js Image Optimization for all media assets.
- Tailwind CSS purging for minimal production CSS payload.

### 23.3 Reliability & Idempotency
- Automation workflow triggers must be idempotent — retrying the same trigger must not produce duplicate events or messages.
- CSV bulk imports must detect and skip duplicate leads (match by email or phone).

### 23.4 Accessibility
- ARIA roles, `aria-checked`, `aria-label` on all interactive elements.
- Full keyboard navigation for modals, drawers, and form elements.
- Semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `footer`, `section`, `address`).
- WCAG AA colour contrast across both light (public) and dark (admin) modes.

### 23.5 SEO (Public Portal)
- Unique `<title>` + `<meta description>` per page via Next.js `metadata` export.
- Single `<h1>` per page with proper heading hierarchy.
- Semantic markup throughout.
- Vercel Analytics integration.
